description: Lacombe Stormwater Pond Dataset is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Stormwater ponds are artificial structures that are critical components of stormwater management systems in many Canadian cities. They serve to prevent flooding of urban areas during excess rainfall. Stormwater ponds also contribute to environmental health by allowing the settlement of dirt and solids from stormwater to the bottom of the pond. Coverage: Government of Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Its tags are Lacombe, environmental health, environmental public health, stocked ponds, stormwater. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, XLS. The portal shows 2026-03-04 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
